F_semantics: Workbook NOTE states that information not disclosed in the original operational-risk event text is populated with F.
event_row_rule: Event ID must be an integer; exact IDs 1..3723 are required. The sole non-integer Event ID cell is the workbook NOTE and is not an event.

non_event_note.event_id_literal: NOTE：All information that was not disclosed in the original operational risk event text is populated with F

occurrence_date_rule: admit only integer Occurrence year plus integer Occurrence month in 1..12; F/blank/other non-integer components are missing/unparseable and excluded, never imputed
